text: Training Center has teaching faculty with profound knowledge and rich experiences in the training of the Chinese Language.It offers effective training programs all the year round for those who wish to improve their Chinese Language proficiency. Students can choose classes at different levels according to their own levels. Class Level Class Name Schedule Objective Intermediate Chinese I Intermediate Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in September every year. For students who already have more than 2000 words or have learned Chinese for more than 800 class hours, they can learn more than 3500 words, read Chinese newspaper, write essay more than 300 words and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester. Writing Intermediate Listening and Speaking Newspaper and Magazine Reading Intermediate Chinese II Intermediate Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in Feburary or March every year. For students who already have more than 3500 words or have learned Chinese for more than 1200 class hours, they can learn more than 5000 words, make more complete conversation in social and economic phenomena, read Chinese newspaper more quickly, write essay more than 400 words and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester.
